title: checklist api-backend.automation-namespace-address acceptance[8]: re-point Allow to the automation domain's GET after #33026
body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

Kind: stale spec, so this is a re-point card (`checklist-test` §5). The product is right; the clause is old.

- acceptance[8].verify (rev 5) expects `DELETE` on the addressed runs list to answer 405 with `Allow: GET, HEAD`. That is the transport's answer: the clause cites the Hono adapter adding HEAD.
- Since #33026 (PR #33926), the addressed `/automation/:ns/:name/(runs|trigger)` shapes are handed to `dispatch()`. The automation domain answers exactly as on the bare path: 405 with `Allow: GET` (`automationRouteAllow`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-address.ts`) and the dispatcher envelope `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED","message":"Method not allowed","httpStatus":405}}`. That shape is pinned by `packages/runtime/src/automation-every-verb.hono.integration.test.ts`.
- Measured in two runs this round, both reproduced:
  - at `f6f5b50a` (#34801), twice;
  - at `f02f4f63` (#34802), three times.
  `DELETE /api/v1/automation/showcase/showcase_batch_reminders/runs` → 405 `allow: GET`, byte-identical to the bare `DELETE /api/v1/automation/showcase_batch_reminders/runs`. `HEAD` on the same path answers 200.

Re-point acceptance[8].verify to read "405 with `Allow: GET` in the dispatcher envelope, identical to the bare path", drop the Hono-adapter HEAD sentence, cite #33026, then bump the revision and add a `history` line.

Separate and minor, not part of this card: whether a domain 405 should also list the HEAD it actually serves.
